//: Each entry under `models` is an addressable model the agent can talk to.
Each entry under `roles` maps a logical role onto one of those models.
`executor` (the only role allowed to mutate state). Legacy names
`coder` and `planner` are still accepted and alias to `orchestrator`.
Change a model assignment at runtime in the REPL with `/model <role>=<model-id>`.
`mcp` is an optional per-model list of MCP server names (e.g. `fsmcp`, `codemcp`)
the model can access. It layers on top of the role split: a model only sees
tools from servers that are both role-appropriate AND listed here. Omit the key
for no restriction; an empty array advertises zero tools.
`fsreadonly`/`excelreadonly` are inspection-only mounts of the same servers:
give them to orchestrator-role models so the read-only contract is ENFORCED
(mutating tools not mounted), and reserve `fsmcp`/`excel` for executor models.
`iterationCap` is an optional per-model override of the role's iteration cap;
omit it to fall back to maxExecutorIterationsPerAsk / maxOrchestratorIterations.

qwen-coder.description: Strong 30B coding model with native Ollama tool calling. NOTE: ~18 GB — overflows a 16 GB GPU and crashes llama-server at CUDA init; use qwen-coder-14b until more VRAM is available.

qwen-coder-14b.description: Coder model that fits in 16 GB VRAM (~9 GB). Default executor; replaces qwen3-coder:30b which overflows the GPU.

deepseek-r1.description: Reasoning-focused model. Available for orchestrator if you prefer planning depth over tool reliability; <think> blocks are stripped before handoff.

llama-fast.description: Small, quick model for summarization and lightweight follow-ups.

claude-haiku-4-5.description: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 (cloud). Fast, reliable judge — used for the evaluator/completion gate. Output $5. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite.description: Google most cost-efficient model, optimized for high-volume agentic tasks, translation, and simple data processing.. Output $1.50. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite-coder.description: Google smallest and most cost effective model, built for at scale usage. Output $0.40. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite-orchestrator.description: Google smallest and most cost effective model, built for at scale usage. Output $0.40. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.
